items.title: Live updates: BTC tops $76,000; bitcoin, ether ETFs pull in $800 million
items.snippet: Spot bitcoin ETFs pulled in $606 million on Aug. 20 and ether funds $221 million, both bigger than the prior day, confirming the institutional bid behind bitcoin's run.
